_howto: Elections polled by the California SOS adapter (server/src/adapters/casos.js). base is the SOS results API. candidateRaces: statewide candidate contests, each with the API slug of its statewide file and (optionally) its county map file. houseSlug returns every U.S. House district (statewide per district; the API has no county breakdown for House that we found). measuresSlug is the statewide measures file; countyMeasures:true also fetches {measuresSlug}/county/{slug} for each county (58 requests, only when the statewide files change). statusSlug gives county turnout; it is ignored when its lastReportTimestamp is older than the election date (it held Sep 2024 test data on the afternoon of 2026-11-03). CA has no U.S. Senate race in 2026 (/returns/us-senate answers 500).
